description:
Solution Component Extractor helps you build a smaller Dynamics 365 / Dataverse solution from a big one, when only a hotfix or a single feature has to move to another environment.

Open an unmanaged solution .zip exported from Dataverse: every component is listed and grouped by type (tables, forms, views, choices, security roles, processes and cloud flows, web resources, apps, site maps, PCF controls, plug-in assemblies and steps, environment variables, connection references...). Keep or remove a whole type in one click, or pick components one by one. A live preview shows customizations.xml and solution.xml exactly as they will be generated.

The new solution keeps the same format and publisher as the original. Definitions, files, relationships and missing dependencies of removed components are cleaned up, and files still used by a kept component are never deleted. You can give it a new name and version, save it as a .zip or import it directly into the connected environment.

Clear warnings help you avoid empty or failing imports: managed components exported without content, processes running on a removed table, components removed together with their table.

No connection is needed to build the solution. Unmanaged solutions only.
releaseNotes:
1.0.1.0 - First release

- Open an unmanaged solution .zip by drag and drop or Browse; managed solutions are rejected with an explanation.
- All root components listed and grouped by type, with a kept / total counter per type.
- Keep or remove a whole type in one click, or components one by one; search, sort, right-click bulk actions (keep, remove, keep only selected).
- Live read-only preview of customizations.xml and solution.xml, updated at each change; click a component to jump to its XML block.
- Generated solution keeps the source format and publisher; definitions, files, relationships, field mappings and missing dependencies of removed components are cleaned up.
- New unique name, display name and version for the generated solution, validated as you type.
- Warnings before generating: unmodified managed components (no content to import), processes running on a removed table, components removed with their table.
- Direct import into the connected environment, with readable error messages and the list of failed components.
- Activity panel with removed files and warnings, built-in help, modern dialogs.
